purpose: Ownership and public review-field structures for governance operations. No staff names, dates, or approvals are invented here.

reviewedBy.label: Reviewed By
reviewedBy.meaning: Genuine reviewer attribution approved for public display.

contentOwner.label: Content Owner
contentOwner.meaning: Accountable department confirmed by practice management.

lastReviewed.label: Last Reviewed
lastReviewed.meaning: Actual reviewer sign-off date, not a website publish date.

nextReview.label: Next Review Due
nextReview.meaning: Approved next review due date. Shown publicly only while current.

visibility.runtime: site.js reads governance-published.js and keeps the host hidden when evidence is incomplete or expired

knowledge_article.intervalGuidance: 12 months, or when the clinical meaning changes

knowledge_centre.intervalGuidance: 12 months, or when the clinical meaning changes

service.intervalGuidance: 12 months, or when scope, fees, or booking rules change

practice_information.suggestedReviewerRole: Operational reviewer, or authorised clinician when the page is clinical policy
practice_information.intervalGuidance: 6 months, or the day a fee, hour, access, or policy fact changes

governance.suggestedReviewerRole: Institutional or clinical reviewer according to the page
governance.intervalGuidance: 12 months, or when accreditation or policy statements change

practitioner.suggestedReviewerRole: The practitioner confirms the profile; an authorised clinician reviews clinical claims
practitioner.intervalGuidance: 12 months, or when the practitioner joins, leaves, or changes interests or booking rules
